product_family: AI recruiting suite with two distinct products: SeekOut Recruit (self-serve AI sourcing/screening/outreach platform for in-house recruiters) and SeekOut Spot (managed, agentic-AI-plus-human-recruiter sourcing service); also offers a ChatGPT-integrated search experience.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SeekOut is SOC 2 Type 2 certified as of June 8, 2023.' Trust center resource list also shows 'SeekOut SOC 2 Type II June 2025' as the most-accessed report.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: SeekOut is compliant with ISO/IEC: 42001:2023 and ISO/IEC: 23894:2023. The vendor states 'compliant with' (a self-attested alignment), not third-party 'certified'; 42001 is a certifiable management-system standard, so this reflects a stated AI-governance compliance posture rather than a confirmed audited certificate.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023 (AI risk management guidance)
certifications.proof_quote: SeekOut is compliant with ISO/IEC: 42001:2023 and ISO/IEC: 23894:2023. 23894 is a guidance standard, not third-party certifiable in the way 27001/42001 are, so this reflects a stated governance-framework alignment rather than an audited certificate.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: SeekOut's own security page lists 'SOC 2, ISO/IEC, CSA/CCM, ITAR, CJIS, HIPAA and IRS 1075' as certifications held by Microsoft Azure (the hosting infrastructure), not by SeekOut itself. No ISO 27001 certificate is claimed for SeekOut/ZipStorm as an organization on the security page or trust center.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA appears only in the list of certifications held by Microsoft Azure ('Microsoft Azure ... HIPAA') on SeekOut's security page and is not claimed as a SeekOut/ZipStorm compliance status anywhere on the trust center or privacy policy.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations' with documented data processing agreements; trust center Compliance tab lists 'GDPR' alongside SOC 2 and CCPA.

certifications.name: CCPA
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center Compliance tab shows 'CCPA ... COMPLIANT'.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence: PCI DSS is not mentioned on the trust center, security page, or privacy policy. SeekOut does not appear to process payment card data directly, so this framework is likely out of scope rather than a gap.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a FedRAMP authorization on any vendor-domain page reviewed.

privacy.ai_training_note: SeekOut's security page states plainly: 'SeekOut does not use any client data to train our AI models' and 'does not test its software with customer data' or 'use client data to enhance its own data.' Separately, the privacy policy confirms SeekOut does not use Google Workspace API data 'to develop, improve, or train generalized/non-personalized AI or machine learning models.' The privacy policy does note SeekOut uses machine learning internally to generate inferences (e.g., job mobility, demographic characteristics) about candidates already in its own sourced database, which is a distinct practice from training on a customer's own tenant data.
privacy.data_region: United States (Microsoft Azure US data centers); SeekOut states it 'complies with our obligations under data processing agreements with our customers, including applicable standard contractual clauses' for transfers from the EEA and other jurisdictions to the US.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ required; 'The SeekOut service can only be accessed by secure HTTPS connection'

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES-256; 'All customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest'

security.name: Key management
security.value: Encryption keys managed by Microsoft Azure

security.name: Hosting infrastructure
security.value: Runs on Microsoft Azure, 'SOC 2 certified data centers in the United States'; daily backups geographically distributed

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Third-party pentest at least annually; trust center lists 'Recruit Pentest Results 2025' as a published resource; monthly vulnerability scans on webapps/networks

security.name: Fairness/bias auditing
security.value: Independent bias audits published for both products: 'Bias Audit - SeekOut Recruit' and 'Bias Audit - SeekOut Spot'

security.name: Cyber insurance
security.value: Trust center lists a 'Certificate of CyberInsurance' as an available resource

security.name: Subprocessors disclosed
security.value: Trust center subprocessor list includes Microsoft Azure (cloud hosting, US), Intercom (support widget, US), Atlassian SSO/Jira/Confluence (support ticketing, US)

products.name: SeekOut Recruit
products.data_scope: Customer ATS data plus SeekOut's 1B+ sourced candidate profile database; recruiter-controlled sourcing, AI screening/scoring of applicants, outreach campaigns
products.notes: Primary self-serve product; free trial offered.

products.name: SeekOut Spot
products.data_scope: Candidate resumes, screening transcripts, and evaluation packets handled directly by SeekOut's own agentic AI and human recruiters on the customer's behalf
products.notes: Higher data-handling exposure than Recruit because SeekOut staff/AI conduct outreach and screening directly rather than the customer's own recruiters; sold via custom engagement, not self-serve.

products.name: SeekOut in ChatGPT
products.data_scope: Exposes SeekOut sourcing capability inside ChatGPT; scope of data shared with/through OpenAI's platform is not detailed in vendor-domain material reviewed
products.notes: Newly promoted on the homepage; no dedicated security/privacy disclosure found for this integration specifically, worth a follow-up question for enterprise buyers.

compare.pricing_model: Custom/enterprise quote-based pricing for both products; free trial available for SeekOut Recruit, no public self-serve pricing for SeekOut Spot
compare.data_residency: United States (Microsoft Azure US regions), with SCC-based safeguards for EEA/international transfers

flags: SeekOut's own /security page lists Microsoft Azure's certifications (SOC 2, ISO/IEC, CSA/CCM, ITAR, CJIS, HIPAA, IRS 1075) alongside SeekOut's own SOC 2 Type II claim. A careless reader could mistake Azure's ISO/IEC and HIPAA coverage for SeekOut's own certification status; no vendor-level (as opposed to host-level) ISO 27001 or HIPAA attestation was found for SeekOut itself.

Trust center (trust.seekout.com) requires 'Request access' for full document access; this report reflects the publicly visible summary page plus corroborating detail from the public /security page and privacy policy, not the underlying signed audit reports themselves.

ISO/IEC 23894:2023 is a risk-management guidance standard, not a certifiable management-system standard like 27001/42001; listing it alongside 42001 as a 'certification' on the vendor's own page is a mild over-statement.

No distinct security/privacy disclosure found for the new 'SeekOut in ChatGPT' integration; enterprise buyers evaluating that surface should ask SeekOut directly what data crosses into OpenAI's platform.
